findings.message: bug-proposal: features/specs/citations.py resolves a `specs/`/`dadaia_workspace/`/`.github/`-prefixed citation token against repo_root with no traversal or symlink containment check
findings.detail_md: `dadaia_workspace/features/specs/citations.py:101-108` (`dead_path_citations`) checks `token.startswith(CITABLE_PATH_PREFIXES)` and then calls `(repo_root / token).exists()` directly -- there is no `.resolve()` followed by an `is_relative_to(repo_root)` (or equivalent) containment check anywhere in this module. A citation token such as `` `specs/../../../etc/passwd` `` (which passes the prefix check because `str.startswith` does not interpret `..`) would be existence-checked against a path outside the repository tree. The same gap applies to every tree-walking entry point that shares this finder (`dead_path_citations_in_tree`, `memory_citation_violations`) and to `_markdown_files()`'s `root.glob('**/*.md')`, which follows symlinks with no `is_symlink()` guard, mirroring the LOW finding on `features/specs/candidate.py` carried in every prior 0.4.7 verdict. CWE-22 (Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory). Ruled out as agent error/wrong usage/environment limit: this is a missing containment check in new, shipped production code, reproducible by inspection alone (`grep -n 'resolve()\|is_relative_to\|is_symlink' dadaia_workspace/features/specs/citations.py` returns zero matches). Judged non-blocking at LOW: the citation text this module scans is version-controlled `specs/memory/**` and `public/**` prose that only an operator or an agent with existing commit access can author; the only observable effect of an escaping token is a boolean folded into a WARNING-severity, unfixable doctor description (MEM-DRIFT-2) -- no file content is read, no network or authenticated boundary is crossed, and doctor never displays the resolved absolute path.
findings.fix_recommendation: Operator-confirmed bug proposal, not yet registered (no operator present in this review session, per dd-bug-registration). If confirmed: `dadaia bugs append --bug-id citations-dead-path-no-repo-root-containment --reported-by security-reviewer --title "dead_path_citations resolves a prefixed token against repo_root with no traversal/symlink containment" --severity LOW --surface dadaia_workspace/features/specs/citations.py --component specs-doctor --context dadaia-workspace --symptom "a citation token starting with a citable prefix but containing .. or resolving through a symlink is existence-checked outside repo_root, with no resolve()+is_relative_to guard" --repro "grep -n 'resolve()\\|is_relative_to\\|is_symlink' dadaia_workspace/features/specs/citations.py" --expected "dead_path_citations resolves repo_root/token, calls .resolve(strict=False), and treats a result outside repo_root.resolve() the same as a dead citation, never calling .exists() on an out-of-tree path". Fix (structural, not this reviewer's to write): add one `Path.resolve()` + `is_relative_to(repo_root.resolve())` guard at the single point citations.py joins repo_root with a token, shared by every caller -- matching the pattern already recommended for candidate.py.
